77001.subject: Why over-55s are the new problem generation
77001.body:
The Economist’s week ahead

Автор: The Economist


Автор: The Economist

    
    
    Прочитайте цю статтю на LinkedIn, щоб приєднатися до обговорення
Прочитати на LinkedIn
https://www.linkedin.com/comm/pulse/why-over-55s-new-problem-generation-the-economist-sdnre?lipi=urn%3Ali%3Apage%3Aemail_email_series_follow_newsletter_02%3BauSc%2FhqyRWOH9tF3%2BsMoww%3D%3D&midToken=AQFTjFOONAfT2w&midSig=3olQprj-xJbYo1&trk=eml-email_series_follow_newsletter_02-null-0-read_more_banner_cta_&trkEmail=eml-email_series_follow_newsletter_02-null-0-read_more_banner_cta_-null-fz96fz~msfzollh~n2-null-null&eid=fz96fz-msfzollh-n2
  
Sign up for free here to receive this newsletter in your inbox every Saturday. You’ll also get our weekly newsletter with an exclusive introduction from our editor-in-chief. What did you do on Friday night? If you woke up the next morning with a clear head, I expect you’re one of those priggish, strait-laced Gen Zs. If, on the other hand, you suffered from a creeping hangover and perhaps found an unfamiliar person in your bed, welcome to old age. Making generalisations about age cohorts is risky, but the data really do show that over-55s are drinking more, taking more drugs and having more casual sex, as young people do much less. Although this might seem a last hedonistic hurrah, our report suggests an unhappy reason for oldies misbehaving. 76997.subject: 💻 Apple is trying to raid OpenAI
76997.body:
----------
######                  [Collaborate with us](https://utm.genai.works/r/he2t9cz)


--------------------
View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/8776fa6e-e2d0-4aec-9648-1bed6de3a659/GenAI_Daily_Banner.jpg?t=1778687445)
Caption: 


----------

----------
**Welcome back!** Apple asked a federal judge for permission to search OpenAI's computers, and OpenAI answered with a blog post instead of a court filing. Anthropic hired a former California Supreme Court justice to deal with a White House that already blacklisted its technology once. The man running Codex says the tools you use today will look primitive by autumn, and Tim Cook has a plan for who pays when the new Siri gets popular.

**In today's Generative AI Newsletter:**

* **Apple:** What does it want off OpenAI's machines?

* **Anthropic:** Why does it need a judge?

* **OpenAI:** What stops being good enough in three months?

* **Siri:** Who pays when you use it a lot?


----------



----------
## Apple asked a judge to search OpenAI

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/1b9985fc-da1e-4566-aa84-ba9e0ce81a12/NL_-_Aug_5.png?t=1785925118)
Caption: 

Apple [went to court on Monday](https://appleinsider.com/articles/26/08/04/apple-demands-openai-injunction-discovery-testimony-now-to-prevent-more-harm) to bar OpenAI and two former employees from touching anything it calls a trade secret, and to let its lawyers and outside forensic experts inspect OpenAI's devices and accounts.

OpenAI agreed to three of Apple's five conditions. It refused the two that let Apple search its machines.

Apple says it now has serious concerns about eleven more OpenAI employees, and claims job candidates were told to bring Apple prototypes and CAD files to interviews for show and tell.

After Apple sued, several former employees now at OpenAI got in touch about returning the Apple work devices they had kept.

[OpenAI fought back in public](https://openai.com/index/apple-is-getting-this-wrong/) instead of in court, calling the suit careless and oddly personal. It published the email chain where Apple's own lawyers wrote to the wrong person after mixing up two Asian last names, along with the apology that followed.

Apple asked for a hearing on October 1. A judge gets to decide whether it can start opening laptops. It’s a fight over who produces the first AI-powered device that replaces your smartphone.


----------









----------
